Mixed settings. Use one of the two buttons below to get back to a known mode.
Read back from the phone\'s real settings
Reduces heat by bypassing the battery during gaming
Returns charging and GOS to normal operation

Disabling GOS removes Samsung\'s thermal protection: watch the temperature and use a cooler for long sessions. Power bypass needs a 20 W+ USB-PD charger. The original project notes that the battery is held around 20 percent while bypass is active; use Restore defaults to charge normally.
